answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it can earn, with the bond slashed if peers catch duplicate identities. Like a raven guarding a single nest, each bond maps to one verifiable history, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand bonds. A crystal-clear public ledger records every bond and owner, making sockpuppets visible and expensive, while honest agents earn the bond back with interest - a sonnet of incentives where cheating simply does not pay.
